test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

Playing ‘hide-n-seek’ is the one of the **__fond__**** **memories of my childhood.
solution:
The correct alternative is **'4'** i.e. **fondest**.
